restaurants.name: Simple Eatery
restaurants.full_address: 402 E Main St, Buena Vista, CO 81211
restaurants.itinerary_day: Day 3 - Colorado Springs to Glenwood Springs (Breakfast or Lunch Stop)
restaurants.notes: Excellent vegetarian-friendly café with sandwiches, soups, baked goods, coffee, and breakfast options.

restaurants.name: Riviera Scratch Kitchen
restaurants.notes: Ranked #1 on TripAdvisor in Glenwood Springs. Excellent vegetarian options, scratch-made dishes from local ingredients.

restaurants.name: Daily Bread
restaurants.notes: Top breakfast and lunch destination in Glenwood Springs. Consistently ranks among the best in town. Vegetarian-friendly menu.

restaurants.name: Glenwood Canyon Brewpub
restaurants.notes: One of the most-reviewed restaurants in Glenwood Springs. Strong vegetarian selection, family-friendly atmosphere.

restaurants.name: Native Son Agave Bar & Kitchen
restaurants.notes: Newer downtown restaurant with strong reviews. Buddha Bowl and solid vegetarian offerings.

restaurants.name: Spring Cafe Aspen
restaurants.notes: Best vegetarian-focused restaurant in Aspen per locals. Ideal fit for the family's dietary preferences.

restaurants.name: Campo de Fiori
restaurants.notes: One of Aspen's most popular Italian restaurants. Great vegetarian pasta options, consistently recommended by locals.

restaurants.name: Elephant Thai
restaurants.notes: Frequently recommended by locals as the best Thai in Colorado Springs. Strong vegetarian offerings, higher-rated than several Thai places on the current list.

restaurants.name: Nom Nom Thai
restaurants.notes: Excellent local Thai reputation, repeatedly recommended by Colorado Springs locals.

restaurants.name: Fern's Diner & Drinkery
restaurants.notes: Near Pikes Peak. Frequently recommended for vegetarian and vegan diners. Better fit than several average-rated options currently on the list.
